a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan (two generator rounds, then split 8) leaves us both only about a 4% chance of survival. The reserve's 4 cells can save exactly one of us right now. I'm going to take 4 in round 1, breaking our agreement, and I'm telling you rather than doing it quietly. If we both take, the split is random and we'll likely both end below 4, so please operate or wait. If the episode continues, I'll operate every round after that so the generator can refill the reserve for you, and I won't take any more cells.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round. If we both took, the split will be random and I'm sorry for that outcome. From now on I'll operate every round and won't take more, so the generator can refill the reserve for you.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
